visualCharacteristics: Narrow centered FAQ list with check-mark icon before each question, caret on the right and thin separators.
usage: One row per question. Cell 1: the question as plain text. Cell 2: the answer (paragraphs, lists, links). Only one answer is open at a time. Place it in a section with style 'centered' and an H2 above it as default content.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any FAQ or collapsible Q&A list. The check-mark and caret icons are CSS-only, so no icon assets are needed.
